speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a pediatric patient with multiple skin lesions. To help me understand your condition, can you tell me how long you have had these spots and if they are itchy or painful?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-year-old female. The patient's mother reports noticing multiple painless, nonpruritic papules on the child's abdomen. The child attends daycare where another child was reported to have similar lesions recently. Patient's brother had chickenpox one month ago. Immunizations are up-to-date.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Molluscum Contagiosum.

Based on the history of painless, non-itchy papules in a daycare setting with a recent exposure, this is highly characteristic of Molluscum Contagiosum. Given your brother's recent chickenpox, do you want me to perform a visual skin exam to confirm the specific appearance of these lesions?
